people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
translations.bsb: Then Sarah said, “God has made me laugh, and everyone who hears of this will laugh with me.”
translations.kjv: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh
translations.asv: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh. Every one that heareth will laugh with me.
